entry.name: buffir~
entry.description: Use buffir~ object when you need a finite impulse response (FIR) filter that convolves an input signal with samples from an input buffer.

arguments.name: buffer-name
arguments.description: The name of aobject whichuses to filter the input signal.

arguments.name: read-offset
arguments.description: The offset, in samples, into theobject beforebegins reading samples to construct the filter. The default is 0.

arguments.name: read-duration
arguments.digest: Size of input buffer to use when filtering
arguments.description: The size, in samples, of the slice in thewhichwill use for the filter. The default is 0, and the maximum is 4096.
